evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared strategy is 시장이익최대 (market profit maximization), which requires high-TRL, near-market technologies with short timelines; instead, the portfolio is entirely composed of TRL-1 exploratory research projects with executability scores of 1.0, directly contradicting commercialization-focused strategy.
evidence.competitive_awareness: There is no evidence of competitor positioning, differentiation rationale, or timing designed relative to competitive landscape; technology selections appear made purely on internal logic without any visible awareness of where competitors stand in High-Ni, all-solid-state, or silicon anode development.
evidence.market_timing: For 시장이익최대, completion should fall within ±0.5 years of boom; mean timing error is 2.19 years with TECH-006 missing its boom by 3.5 years and TECH-003 by 2.5 years — all technologies complete significantly after their respective market boom windows, representing systematic late-to-market failure.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: While the selected technologies (High-Ni cathode, silicon anode, all-solid-state) do represent areas of known patent-market activity in battery materials, the selections show no deliberate convergence-zone targeting evidenced by explicit scoring or reasoning — the overlap appears coincidental given the domain rather than intentional strategy.
